page.overview:
What is Valley of Banof?

The Valley of Banof is a fictional location created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his short story "Polaris".

A valley in the far northern kingdom of Lomar in the Dreamlands, the Valley of Banof can be seen at a distance from the Watchtower of Thapnen in the city of Olathoë. (: "Polaris")
